notes: Annotations apply to central individual view frames, not the entire interval.
View timestamps may differ and earlier synchronization is uncertain; do not force matching contact labels.
A=easy no-hand negative, N=clear hand-gap negative, U=unknown contact. Only new N frames from training takes can be added.
Focused sheets contain the same selected source frames, enlarged only for review; fitted descriptors are unchanged.
Held midpoint audit adds no positive labels and separates low motion from visible lowering.
